conclusions.text: All exact issue-scoped source IDs were found and the two retained sources support distinct but still unverified current legal roles.
Twenty Cameroon source-name/Atlas-parent combinations do not match the extracted 2021 official nomenclature crosswalk and require reconciliation.
The current legal boundary, complete national coverage, disconnected/island/city-fragment treatment and full parent fit remain unresolved for both scoped countries.
Historical cache hash meaning and source-to-Atlas geometry preparation lineage remain unresolved.
The two CAF Nola source/Atlas identities occur under distinct parent IDs; the supported current identity and parent relationship remain unresolved.
